title: GoogLeNet / Inception Research Publication
summary: Christian Szegedy and coauthors submitted 'Going Deeper with Convolutions' on September 17, 2014, presenting the Inception deep convolutional architecture and identifying GoogLeNet as a 22-layer incarnation used for ILSVRC 2014.
significance: A documented computer-vision architecture milestone focused on improving computational-resource utilization while increasing network depth and width, with state-of-the-art ILSVRC 2014 classification and detection results reported in the paper.

verification.note: The primary arXiv record establishes the September 17, 2014 submission date, authorship, Inception architecture description, GoogLeNet naming, 22-layer depth, and ILSVRC 2014 context. Google Research independently preserves the publication and corroborates the title, authors, Inception framing, GoogLeNet identity, 22-layer description, and CVPR 2015 publication context. This record intentionally uses the dated arXiv submission as the event boundary. It does not reinterpret that date as a commercial product launch, API release, deployment date, unrestricted availability milestone, geography claim, or evidence of causal influence on later systems. No ancestry, influence, causality, geography, or relationships are inferred.
